transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I've been losing a lot of weight recently, and it's starting to really concern me. I've also found myself eating only extremely small amounts of food lately.
When you look in the mirror, how do you feel about your body? Are you afraid of gaining weight?

When I look in the mirror, I still feel like I'm too big and desperately need to lose more weight. I am absolutely terrified of gaining even a tiny amount, and the thought of putting on weight makes me panic. Because of this, I find myself constantly checking the scale to make sure I haven't gained anything.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "menstrual history",
  "question": "Have you been having regular menstrual periods, or have they stopped recently?"
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't paid close attention to my menstrual cycle recently.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "menstrual history",
  "question": "Can you recall when your last period was, or whether you've missed any periods in the past few months?"
I honestly can't recall when my last period was. I haven't been keeping track of my cycle at all lately, so I'm not sure if I've missed any.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "menstrual history",
  "question": "How long has it been since you’ve had a menstrual period? If you're unsure, have you gone three months or more without a period recently?"
I'm really not sure if it has been three months or not. I just haven't been keeping track of my cycle at all lately, so I can't give you an accurate timeline.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "weight and BMI assessment",
  "question": "Can you tell me how much you weigh now, and have you reached a very low weight for your height?"

I currently weigh around 90 pounds, which I know is considered very low for my height. However, I still feel like it's not low enough, and I am absolutely terrified of gaining any of that weight back.

{
  "category": "diagnostic confirmation",
  "subcategory": "eating behavior and weight control",
  "question": "Have you been restricting your food intake, exercising excessively, or using any other methods like vomiting or laxatives to prevent weight gain?"
Yes, I severely restrict my food intake by skipping meals and only eating tiny amounts because I am terrified of gaining weight. I don't throw up or use laxatives to control my weight, though.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were ["Anorexia Nervosa"], and based on this conversation, the diagnosis remains strongly supported. The patient reports significant weight loss, a current weight of 90 pounds (which is very low for most adult heights), an intense fear of gaining weight, persistent behaviors restricting food intake, and body image disturbance (feeling 'too big' despite being underweight). The patient denies use of compensatory behaviors such as vomiting or laxatives, which rules out bulimia nervosa and supports the restricting subtype of anorexia. While menstrual history is unclear due to patient's lack of tracking, the combination of low weight and amenorrhea (likely given the context) further supports the diagnosis. No new candidates are added, and Anorexia Nervosa remains the only likely diagnosis at this time.
